title: Add semantics to PIN numpad icon-only controls and remove the fixed-height digit-key wrapper
why: The AppBar close IconButton and the numpad's backspace key are icon-only with no tooltip/Semantics label, so a screen-reader user cannot identify either control (the digit keys are fine — their Text child is auto-exposed). Separately, _TutorPinKey wraps its child (a 24sp digit Text at default scale) in a fixed SizedBox(height: 52); no global TextScaler clamp exists in this app (verified via grep), so at large accessibility text-scale settings the digit glyph can exceed the fixed box and clip or overflow visually.
recommendation: Add `tooltip:` to the close IconButton and wrap the backspace Icon in Semantics(label: ...) or give it a tooltip; remove the fixed height on _TutorPinKey (let it size to content with padding, or clamp textScale for the digit only).
acceptance_criteria: the close button and backspace key have non-empty semantic labels verifiable via a Semantics-tree widget test
a widget test at textScale 2.0+ confirms no RenderFlex overflow/clip on the numpad (would confirm the AX-4 half of this finding at runtime)
